card: Card 06 — Robustecer a captura de fala e o transporte em tempo real
notes: modelLoadMs reflects a warmed browser cache and is not a cold-download guarantee
inferenceMs is local browser execution on this machine, not a universal latency promise
controlled synthetic WER does not replace real-user validation across accents, microphones and rooms
